macros.name: proofdotnumber
macros.doc: \proofdotseparation and \proofdotnumber control the size of the string of dots.

macros.name: proofdotseparation
macros.doc: \proofdotseparation and \proofdotnumber control the size of the string of dots.

macros.name: shiftleft
macros.doc: By default the conclusion is centered wrt the left-most and right-most immediate hypotheses (not their proofs); \shiftright or \shiftleft moves it relative to this position.

macros.name: shiftright
macros.doc: By default the conclusion is centered wrt the left-most and right-most immediate hypotheses (not their proofs); \shiftright or \shiftleft moves it relative to this position.

macros.name: thickness
macros.doc: \thickness specifies the breadth of the rule in any units, although fontrelative units such as ex or em are preferable.
